ala-baidu-1.webp.en: Almaty's terminal by day — the flowing roofline with its ramp carrying traffic up to departures.

ala-baidu-2.webp.zh: 夜幕下的航站楼：红色霓虹灯「АЭРОПОРТ АЛМАТЫ」在玻璃幕墙上格外醒目。
ala-baidu-2.webp.en: At night the red neon 'АЭРОПОРТ АЛМАТЫ' glows above the glazed frontage.

ala-baidu-3.webp.zh: 冬季的航站楼前：积雪中停着出租车与旅客小巴，屋顶上的菱形装饰清晰可见。
ala-baidu-3.webp.en: A winter view in front of the terminal — taxis and minibuses in the snow beneath the roof's diamond finial.

ala-chatgpt-01.webp.en: The letters ALA dominate the glazed frontage of Almaty's terminal, with the airport's Kazakh and English name beneath.

ala-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Seen from the air, wide lawns separate Almaty's runway from the taxiways while airliners fill the apron by the blue-roofed terminal.

ala-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Several white airliners sit on the apron, one with a green tail, and snow-capped mountains rise beyond in clear air.

ala-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A blue-and-white jet waits on the apron under an overcast sky, a baggage belt marked ALA parked beside it.

ala-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Beneath snowy peaks the roof carries the words ALMATY AIRPORT, with a white jet on the apron and the tower to the left.

ala-chatgpt-06.webp.en: In this daytime aerial, the terminal's pale blue roofs run together, airliners occupy the stands and a building site sits alongside.

ala-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A satellite view of Almaty airport — one long runway cuts diagonally past the apron and taxiways, with dense housing on the other side.
